name: innovate-me
description: A structured creative engine for unusual game concepts, inventive engineering, and testable research ideas.

interface.longDescription: Expand beyond conventional ideas using assumption inversion, distant analogies, and constraint mutation. Explore wild game concepts, unconventional engineering designs, or research hypotheses with clear tests, honest novelty checks, and direct, non-defensive writing.
defaultPrompt: Invent three genuinely different game mechanics using sound.
Find unconventional approaches to low-latency pitch tracking.
Challenge this research idea and propose a decisive experiment.
